brief: What a passwordless account may do by password sign-in, and what creating a user without a password does.
tradeoff: A migrated or blank-created user cannot sign in until an administrator sets a password or the provider links them.
entry: An account without a password never signs in by password, empty included, until an administrator sets one. A user created with a blank password has none. Migrated users need a password set or a provider link. Partly supersedes D-100.
